title: Combining Slimes
statementMd:
Your friend recently gave you some slimes for your birthday. You have a very large amount of slimes with value $1$ and $2$, and you decide to invent a game using these slimes.

You initialize a row with $*n*$ empty spaces. You also choose a number $*p*$ to be used in the game. Then, you will perform the following steps while the last space is empty.

1. With probability ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1a0b7c2218ab69e18b6b844a8281449c263537e3.png), you will choose a slime with value $1$, and with probability ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/917b5cdb9a29867fbc458c1e248e1c7e8a28e099.png), you will choose a slime with value $2$. You place the chosen slime on the last space of the board.
2. You will push the slime to the left as far as possible. If it encounters another slime, and they have the same value $*v*$, you will merge the slimes together to create a single slime with value $*v* + 1$. This continues on until the slime reaches the end of the board, or encounters a slime with a different value than itself.

You have played the game a few times, but have gotten bored of it. You are now wondering, what is the expected sum of all values of the slimes on the board after you finish the game.

## Input

The first line of the input will contain two integers $*n*, *p*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *p* < 10^{9}$).

## Output

Print the expected sum of all slimes on the board after the game finishes. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 4}$.

Namely, let's assume that your answer is $*a*$ and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49eb236611e23b2e7c8e81e9516771daca716eec.png).

## Note

In the first sample, we have a board with two squares, and there is a $0.5$ probability of a `1` appearing and a $0.5$ probability of a `2` appearing.

Our final board states can be `1 2` with probability $0.25$, `2 1` with probability $0.375$, `3 2` with probability $0.1875$, `3 1` with probability $0.1875$. The expected value is thus $(1 + 2)·0.25 + (2 + 1)·0.375 + (3 + 2)·0.1875 + (3 + 1)·0.1875 = 3.5625$.
statementZhMd:
你的朋友最近在生日时送给了你一些史莱姆。你有数量非常多、价值为 $1$ 和 $2$ 的史莱姆，于是决定用这些史莱姆发明一个游戏。

你首先创建一行包含 $*n*$ 个空位的棋盘，并选择一个数 $*p*$ 用于游戏。接下来，只要最后一个位置为空，就重复执行以下步骤：

1. 以概率 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1a0b7c2218ab69e18b6b844a8281449c263537e3.png) 选择一个价值为 $1$ 的史莱姆，以概率 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/917b5cdb9a29867fbc458c1e248e1c7e8a28e099.png) 选择一个价值为 $2$ 的史莱姆。将选中的史莱姆放在棋盘的最后一个位置。
2. 将史莱姆尽可能向左推动。如果它遇到另一个史莱姆，且两个史莱姆的价值均为 $*v*$，则将它们合并为一个价值为 $*v* + 1$ 的史莱姆。这个过程会持续进行，直到该史莱姆到达棋盘的左端，或遇到一个价值与自身不同的史莱姆。

你已经玩过几次这个游戏，但现在对此感到厌倦。于是你想知道，游戏结束后，棋盘上所有史莱姆的价值之和的期望是多少。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*, *p*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *p* < 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

输出游戏结束后棋盘上所有史莱姆价值之和的期望。如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 4}$，则会被判定为正确。

也就是说，假设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测答案为 $*b*$。判题程序将在 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49eb236611e23b2e7c8e81e9516771daca716eec.png) 时判定你的答案正确。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，棋盘有两个格子，出现 `1` 和 `2` 的概率均为 $0.5$。

最终棋盘状态可能为 `1 2`，其概率为 $0.25$；可能为 `2 1`，其概率为 $0.375$；可能为 `3 2`，其概率为 $0.1875$；也可能为 `3 1`，其概率为 $0.1875$。因此，期望值为 $(1 + 2)·0.25 + (2 + 1)·0.375 + (3 + 2)·0.1875 + (3 + 1)·0.1875 = 3.5625$。
